business_summary.text: Panache Digilife is a Design-led Manufacturing (DLM) and Contract-led Manufacturing (CLM) company providing end-to-end product development and manufacturing solutions in the ESDM sector, with a focus on AI-enabled computing, telecom equipment, surveillance, EdTech, and medical devices.

call_points.text: Management expects continued strong growth in FY27 driven by design-led manufacturing and higher-value engagements
Focus on strengthening design and engineering capabilities to address complex technology-intensive requirements
Strong cash conversion cycle improvement to 84 days from 172 days in FY25

guidance.statement: Continued strong growth in FY27 driven by design-led manufacturing and higher-value engagements

operating_notes.text: Technofy Digital Private Limited financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis.
Cash conversion cycle improved to 84 days from 172 days in FY25
Operating EBITDA margin expanded by 372 bps YoY to 10.2%
PAT margin expanded by 447 bps YoY to 7.4%
Q2FY27 revenue expanded by 231.8% YoY to ₹129.60 Cr
Incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary in Hong Kong for trading IT products.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹99.9 Cr (+66.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹9.58 Cr (+323.9% YoY).
In April 2026, Panache Digilife reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹99.90 Cr and approved up to ₹100 Cr capex for its subsidiary Technofy Digital.
In April 2026, Panache Digilife approved an upfront investment of up to ₹2.25 Cr in its wholly owned subsidiary Technofy Digital Private Limited.
Amit Devchand Rambhia, Promoter, confirms no encumbrance on promoters’ and PACs’ shares in Panache Digilife Limited during FY2025-26.
Panache Digilife reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹50.84 Cr, up 72.1% YoY, and PAT of ₹3.81 Cr, up 338.5% YoY, with significant margin expansion.

Panache Digilife Limited scheduled an earnings call on October 27, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST for Q2FY27 results with **Amit Rambhia (MD)**, **Nitesh Savla (CFO & WTD)**, **Neha Madiar (GM-R&D)**, and **Sanjeev Sancheti (IR Advisor)**.
Panache Digilife reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹129.60 Cr; with PAT of ₹9.26 Cr; and announced the allotment of 1,60,300 equity shares upon warrant conversion.
